oneStop.rules: For each trip, also record the cheapest itinerary allowing up to 1 stop per direction/leg, any airline (not limited to CX/AC), layovers capped at 4h. Record price pp, carrier(s), connection point(s), and total extra travel time vs the nonstop reference. Non-CX/AC carriers (e.g. Korean Air) are highlighted on the dashboard.
oneStop.schema: day.trips.<trip>.oneStop = {price, carrier, via, extraTime, legs?[]} — price is pp in the trip's primary cabin series; extraTime is total added time vs nonstop across all directions/legs as '+Xh Ym'; legs[] (familyJapan and optionally round trips) = [{leg, price, carrier, via, dur, extraTime}]
